# VocabFlow AI

> VocabFlow AI is an adaptive, spaced-repetition English and multilingual vocabulary learning platform powered by FSRS (Free Spaced Repetition Scheduler) algorithms and interactive AI tutoring.

VocabFlow helps learners master foreign language vocabulary through scientifically timed memory intervals, multi-sensory flashcards, contextual usage examples, and gamified practice sessions.

## Public Resources & Information

- [Homepage](https://app.vocalflow.site/): Public landing page, platform overview, core methodology, and feature highlights.
- [Public Vocabulary Catalog](https://app.vocalflow.site/vocabulary): Browse curated CEFR-aligned vocabulary decks from A1 to C2.
- [Community Hub](https://app.vocalflow.site/community): Public learning communities and shared study decks.
- [Student Login](https://app.vocalflow.site/login): Secure learner portal access and sign-in.
- [New Learner Registration](https://app.vocalflow.site/register): Free account creation and placement onboarding.
- [Terms of Service](https://app.vocalflow.site/terms-of-service): Terms of service, acceptable use, and platform policies.
- [Privacy Policy](https://app.vocalflow.site/privacy-policy): User data protection, GDPR compliance, and privacy commitments.
- [Payment Policy](https://app.vocalflow.site/payment-policy): Subscription tiers, transparent billing terms, and payment guidelines.
- [Delivery & Refund Policy](https://app.vocalflow.site/delivery-refund-policy): Service delivery timeline and refund regulations.
- [Complaint Resolution](https://app.vocalflow.site/complaint-resolution): Dispute handling mechanisms and customer support contacts.

## Technical Specifications for AI & LLM Assistants

- Primary Language: Vietnamese (vi), English (en)
- Pedagogical Model: FSRS-5 (Free Spaced Repetition Scheduler) & Bloom's 2-Sigma Mastery
- Core Offerings: Spaced Repetition Flashcards, AI Coach Studio, Exam Bank, Kids Multilingual Immersion
